summary: Frontend-only regression for Admin Homepage 'Section Visibility'. All 9 toggles (services, mission, values, featured_projects, credentials, why_choose, team, blog, contact_cta) flip exactly once on a single click (aria-checked true<->false). Persistence verified: toggled 'team' off, clicked save-homepage, reloaded /admin/homepage — state persisted (false). Public homepage (/) then no longer shows the Team section (h2 'Team' heading count went from 1 to 0) while [data-testid=home-services] and [data-testid=certification-band] still render. Restored team to Shown, saved — team heading reappears on public homepage. Login by 'admin' works (redirects to /admin/dashboard). Toggle switches render as pill switches with sliding white knob (green on / grey off) and Shown/Hidden label + status dot; look correct and are clickable.

issues: No data-testid on the Team, Mission/Values, Why-Choose, Featured Projects, Blog and Contact CTA section wrappers on the public /. Only home-services, home-projects, certification-band, home-contact-cta and home-page exist. Adding data-testid=home-team, home-mission, home-values, home-why-choose, home-blog would make section-visibility gating verifiable via testids (currently had to fall back to h2 text).

action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes on remaining public homepage sections (home-team, home-mission, home-values, home-why-choose, home-blog, home-featured-projects) for cleaner automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: toggleSection uses functional setState + `cur = sec[key] !== false` correctly avoids stale-closure / double-toggle. Verified single-click flip on all 9 rows.
Row is a plain div with role=switch, tabIndex=0 and keyboard handler for Enter/Space — accessible and no nested-button issue.
Public Home.jsx gating pattern `home.sections[key] !== false` is safe (defaults undefined -> shown).
seed_data_creation: None. Left all sections back to Shown/true (saved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Section Visibility toggles fully working and persisting. Backend PUT /api/admin/homepage and GET /api/public/home handle the sections object. Public site currently has all sections shown. If adding new sections, follow the same key pattern and gate in Home.jsx with `home.sections[key] !== false`. Note: some public sections lack data-testid (see design_issues).
rca of the issue: Previously (a) leftover false values in DB persisted hidden sections and (b) an intermediate implementation used nested buttons/non-functional state updates causing double-toggle. Fix uses a single clickable div (role=switch) with functional setState — click handler flips once. Verified aria-checked toggles cleanly with a single click for all 9 keys.
